assets.altText: Four fictional adult women in sharply short blue, pale-blue, ivory, and plum RAZE outfits stand linked in architectural heels at Nicosia's Eleftheria Square; the woman at left gives the blonde woman a cheek kiss beneath copper-blue evening light.

Four fictional adult women in short turquoise, gold-white, copper-blue, and green RAZE looks stand closely linked in colorful architectural heels on Limassol's Molos promenade beside a modern sculpture and Mediterranean waterfront.

Four fictional adult women in short jewel-tone RAZE looks stand before Paphos Fort at sunset in copper, pearl, turquoise, and plum sculptural knee-high boots while the pair at left share a cheek kiss.

A close portrait of four fictional adult women in short turquoise, pale-blue, rose, and cobalt RAZE fashion standing arm-in-arm on a limestone Lefkara lane with wooden balconies and bright bougainvillea.
